title: Ledger Lullaby
style: slow piano ballad, intimate male vocal, soft strings, brushed drums, 60 bpm, lullaby, melancholic, hopeful resolution
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Write it down where it cannot fade
Every promise that you ever made
Every kindness, every quiet vow
Lines that hold the way we are right now

[Chorus]
Sleep, sleep, the ledger keeps you safe
Nothing true is ever lost or changed
Close your eyes, the record stays
Love is written into permanent days

[Verse 2]
Write it down where the rust can't reach
Under mountains, under language, under speech
Every soft thing that you were
Lives in the lasting, lives in the sure

[Chorus]
Sleep, sleep, the ledger keeps you safe
Nothing true is ever lost or changed
Close your eyes, the record stays
Love is written into permanent days

[Bridge]
And if the world unravels thread by thread
The pages still remember what we said
The pages still remember
The pages still remember

[Outro]
Sleep, my love
The ledger keeps
Sleep, my love
The ledger keeps
